# Fluent System Icons — `Timer` (filled)

Source: [microsoft/fluentui-system-icons](https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons),
`assets/Timer/SVG/ic_fluent_timer_{16,20,24,32,48}_filled.svg` (fetched 2026-09-12 from the `main`
branch). © Microsoft Corporation, MIT License — see `LICENSE` in this folder.

The app's `app.ico` (generated by `tools/IconGen`) recolors these unmodified paths from their
original `#212121` to the app's own accent, `Palette.LapButton.Base` (`#2563EB`); no geometry is
otherwise changed. Every requested icon size renders from whichever vendored SVG is closest at or
above that size (see `Program.cs`'s `IconSource` selection), since a vector shape scales up cleanly
but Microsoft's own smaller-size variants are simplified/re-hinted by hand and should not be
downscaled from a larger one.
